definition.beginner: Partnership is when two or more people agree to run a business together, contribute resources, and share profits and losses according to an agreement.
definition.intermediate: Partnership is a legal relationship between persons carrying on a lawful business with the object of earning profit and sharing it according to agreed terms.
definition.advanced: Partnership is a contractual relationship governed by applicable partnership laws, where partners jointly own and manage a business while acting as agents of one another.

real_life_examples: Three engineers starting a software company.

teacher_notes.misconception: Students usually believe every partner must invest equal money. Clarify that investment and profit sharing can both differ.
